title: College Banned Dogs. So Lord Byron Got A Bear 🐻
caption:
His college banned dogs. So he got a BEAR 🐻
Wait for the ending 👀

True story (as the story goes). At Trinity College, Cambridge, students were not allowed to keep dogs. The poet Lord Byron is said to have kept a tame bear instead, because the rules said nothing about bears.
Would your landlord allow a bear? 👇
first_comment: Rules said no dogs. Technically correct is the best kind of correct. 🐻👇
